descriptions.zh:
您可以根据需要修改用户的`FirstName`、`LastName`、`DisplayName`、`Email`和`Description`，不能修改用户的`UserName` 。

> 当启用SCIM同步时，不能修改SCIM同步用户的信息。
descriptions.en:
You can modify `FirstName`, `LastName`, `DisplayName`, `Email`, and `Description` for a user. You cannot modify `UserName` for a user.

> If System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) synchronization is enabled, you cannot modify information about a user that is synchronized by using SCIM.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso update-user --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --user-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --new-first-name Alice --new-last-name Lee --new-display-name AliceLee --new-description This_is_a_user. --new-email AliceLee@example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudsso UpdateUser --region cn-hangzhou --NewFirstName Alice --DirectoryId 'd-00fc2p610000' --NewLastName Lee --NewDisplayName AliceLee --NewDescription 'This_is_a_user.' --UserId 'u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000' --NewEmail 'AliceLee@example.com'
